title: Upgrading the Moderation API with our new multimodal moderation model
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial

body:
We’re introducing a new model built on GPT-4o that is more accurate at detecting harmful text and images, enabling developers to build more robust moderation systems.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/upgrading-the-moderation-api-with-our-new-multimodal-moderation-model).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
